 "rationale": "Equal gm/Id and L give matched Vgs for the 20 uA input and 5 uA output devices. Cascode gate vb = Vgs + Vdsat + margin puts both bottom devices at Vds ~ Vdsat, so mirror error is lambda*dV and compliance is ~2*Vdsat + margin. The gate generator is scaled (kR) to calibrate the reference bottom's Vds. Rout ~ gm*ro^2 of the output stack, so L is kept long. Bias current Ib sets vb via a resistor from vdd."

import math

PARAMS = {
    "gmid":   (18.0, 14.0, 22.0),      # nfet gm/Id (sets Vdsat ~ compliance/2)
    "L":      (6.0, 2.0, 15.0),        # um, all mirror devices (sets gain / Rout)
    "ymarg":  (0.02, 0.0, 0.08),       # V, extra headroom on bottom devices
    "Ib":     (4e-6, 1e-6, 20e-6),     # A, cascode-bias generator current
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    iin, iout = spec["iin"], spec["iout_target"]
    g, L = p["gmid"], p["L"]
    Yest = 0.15                                   # expected bottom-device Vds

    # Devices (same gm/Id and L -> matched Vgs; W set by current density)
    mx = lut.size("n", g, L, iin, vds=Yest)       # input bottom  (20 uA)
    mt = mx                                       # input cascode (20 uA)
    mo = lut.size("n", g, L, iout, vds=Yest)      # output bottom (5 uA)
    mc = lut.size("n", g, L, iout, vds=0.6)       # output cascode(5 uA)

    gr = mx.vgs                                   # common bottom gate voltage
    vb = mx.vgs + mx.vdsat + p["ymarg"]           # cascode gate voltage
    Y  = vb - mx.vgs                              # reference bottom Vds
    v2 = vb - mc.vgs                              # output bottom Vds

    # Gate generator: diode device fed by resistor from vdd; scaled by kR so the
    # reference bottom (at Vds=Y) carries exactly iin.
    kR = lut.op("n", mx.W, L, gr, gr)["Id"] / lut.op("n", mx.W, L, gr, Y)["Id"]
    ma = lut.size("n", g, L, kR * iin, vds=gr)

    # Cascode-bias diode device, width chosen so it carries Ib at vb
    id1 = lut.op("n", 1.0, L, vb, vb)["Id"]
    W5 = max(0.42, p["Ib"] / id1)
    Ib_act = lut.op("n", W5, L, vb, vb)["Id"]

    R1 = (VDD - gr) / (kR * iin)                  # gate-generator bias resistor
    R2 = (VDD - vb) / Ib_act                      # cascode-bias resistor

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    n.dev("MT", "iin", "vb", "y", "vss", mt)      # input cascode
    n.dev("MX", "y", "gr", "vss", "vss", mx)      # input bottom (reference)
    n.dev("MA", "gr", "gr", "vss", "vss", ma)     # gate generator (diode)
    n.dev("MC", "iout", "vb", "v2", "vss", mc)    # output cascode
    n.dev("MO", "v2", "gr", "vss", "vss", mo)     # output bottom
    n.M("MB", "vb", "vb", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, L, m=1)   # vb diode
    n.R("R1", "vdd", "gr", R1)
    n.R("R2", "vdd", "vb", R2)

    # Predictions
    id_o = lut.op("n", mo.W, L, gr, v2)["Id"]     # output current at operating Vds
    iout_err_pct = abs(id_o - iout) / iout * 100.0
    rout = mc.intrinsic_gain * mo.intrinsic_gain / mo.gm
    v_compliance = v2 + mc.vdsat
    power = VDD * (iin + kR * iin + Ib_act)

    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": iout_err_pct,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": v_compliance,
        "power": power,
    }
